name: rbac_aad_managed
description: Is the Azure Active Directory integration Managed, meaning that Azure will create/manage the Service Principal used for integration.

name: rbac_aad_admin_group_object_ids
description: Object ID of groups with admin access.

name: client_secret
description: (Optional) The Client Secret (password) for the Service Principal used for the AKS deployment

name: log_retention_in_days
description: The retention period for the logs in days

name: tags
description: Any tags that should be present on the Virtual Network resources

name: vnet_subnet_id
description: (Optional) The ID of a Subnet where the Kubernetes Node Pool should exist. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

name: enable_kube_dashboard
description: Enable Kubernetes Dashboard.

name: enable_role_based_access_control
description: Enable Role Based Access Control.

name: rbac_aad_server_app_id
description: The Server ID of an Azure Active Directory Application.

name: agents_size
description: The default virtual machine size for the Kubernetes agents

name: enable_log_analytics_workspace
description: Enable the creation of azurerm_log_analytics_workspace and azurerm_log_analytics_solution or not

name: network_plugin
description: Network plugin to use for networking.

name: client_id
description: (Optional) The Client ID (appId) for the Service Principal used for the AKS deployment

name: admin_username
description: The username of the local administrator to be created on the Kubernetes cluster

name: log_analytics_workspace_sku
description: The SKU (pricing level) of the Log Analytics workspace. For new subscriptions the SKU should be set to PerGB2018

name: public_ssh_key
description: A custom ssh key to control access to the AKS cluster

name: enable_http_application_routing
description: Enable HTTP Application Routing Addon (forces recreation).

name: rbac_aad_server_app_secret
description: The Server Secret of an Azure Active Directory Application.

name: rbac_aad_client_app_id
description: The Client ID of an Azure Active Directory Application.

name: resource_group_name
description: The resource group name to be imported

name: prefix
description: The prefix for the resources created in the specified Azure Resource Group

name: agents_count
description: The number of Agents that should exist in the Agent Pool

name: os_disk_size_gb
description: Disk size of nodes in GBs.

name: enable_azure_policy
description: Enable Azure Policy Addon.

name: sku_tier
description: The SKU Tier that should be used for this Kubernetes Cluster. Possible values are Free and Paid
